name: What kind of maintenance can help prevent commercial water heater repairs?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance can help prevent commercial water heater repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regular maintenance is crucial for preventing unexpected commercial water heater repairs and extending the unit's lifespan. This includes annual flushing to remove sediment buildup, checking the anode rod for corrosion, inspecting pressure relief valves, and ensuring all connections are secure. Proactive maintenance helps identify potential issues before they escalate into major problems, ensuring consistent hot water and operational efficiency for businesses throughout the Las Vegas service area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent repairs with regular maintenance like annual flushing, anode rod checks, and inspecting pressure relief valves.
